title.zh-CN: MindScope 压力自评（非标准化）

description.zh-CN: MindScope 自编的 10 题压力自评，了解最近两周的压力感受、身心紧张程度和应对资源。这不是标准化量表，分数只适合和自己的历次结果比较。
description.en: A 10-item stress check-in written by MindScope, covering felt pressure, physical and mental tension and coping resources over the last two weeks. It is not a standardized scale; scores are best compared with your own past results.

instructions.zh-CN: 回想最近两周，以下情况出现的频率如何？
instructions.en: Thinking about the last two weeks, how often did the following happen?

licenseNote.zh-CN: MindScope 项目自编，以 CC BY-SA 4.0 发布。
licenseNote.en: Written by the MindScope project, released under CC BY-SA 4.0.

source.zh-CN: MindScope 自编（2026）。尚未经过常模和效度验证，分段仅为粗略参考，不对应任何临床分级。
source.en: Written by MindScope (2026). Not validated against norms; the bands are rough guides and do not correspond to any clinical grading.

citation: MindScope contributors. MindScope Stress Check-in v0.1.0 (non-standardized). 2026. CC BY-SA 4.0.

text.zh-CN: 我觉得要做的事情太多，忙不过来。
text.en: I felt there was too much to do to keep up.

text.zh-CN: 我常常感到紧绷，很难真正松一口气。
text.en: I felt tense and found it hard to really let go.

text.zh-CN: 我很难把注意力集中在手头的事情上。
text.en: I found it hard to concentrate on the task at hand.

text.zh-CN: 我觉得生活或工作中的要求超出了自己能应付的范围。
text.en: The demands of life or work felt like more than I could manage.

text.zh-CN: 压力或心事影响了我的睡眠。
text.en: Stress or worries affected my sleep.

text.zh-CN: 我出现了身体上的紧张反应，比如肩颈僵硬、头痛或肠胃不适。
text.en: I had physical signs of tension, such as a stiff neck, headaches or an upset stomach.

text.zh-CN: 我容易因为小事发脾气或不耐烦。
text.en: Small things made me lose my temper or feel impatient.

text.zh-CN: 我能找到让自己放松下来的办法。
text.en: I could find ways to help myself relax.

text.zh-CN: 我对自己处理问题的方式感到满意。
text.en: I was satisfied with how I handled problems.

text.zh-CN: 遇到压力时，我身边有可以倾诉或求助的人。
text.en: When under pressure, I had someone to talk to or ask for help.

summary.zh-CN: 最近两周感受到的压力相对较少，或者你有比较充足的应对资源。
summary.en: Relatively little felt stress over the last two weeks, or good coping resources.

suggestions.zh-CN: 留意哪些习惯和关系在支持你，继续保持。
suggestions.en: Notice which habits and relationships support you, and keep them up.

summary.zh-CN: 最近有一定的压力感受。适度的压力很常见，关键在于是否有恢复的空间。
summary.en: Some felt stress recently. Moderate stress is common; what matters is having room to recover.

suggestions.zh-CN: 给自己安排固定的休息和放松时间，哪怕每天只有十几分钟。
suggestions.en: Schedule regular rest and relaxation, even ten or fifteen minutes a day.

suggestions.zh-CN: 把待办事项按轻重缓急排序，必要时请别人分担。
suggestions.en: Prioritise your to-dos and ask others to share the load when needed.

suggestions.zh-CN: 规律睡眠和运动是缓解压力最可靠的方法之一。
suggestions.en: Regular sleep and exercise are among the most reliable ways to ease stress.

summary.zh-CN: 最近两周的压力感受比较强，身心可能都有些吃不消。这是一个提醒你照顾自己的信号。
summary.en: Strong felt stress over the last two weeks; body and mind may be stretched. Treat this as a signal to look after yourself.

suggestions.zh-CN: 看看有哪些压力来源可以暂时减少、推迟或寻求帮助。
suggestions.en: Look for sources of pressure that can be reduced, postponed or shared.

suggestions.zh-CN: 和信任的人谈谈，或者向心理咨询师寻求支持。
suggestions.en: Talk with someone you trust, or seek support from a counsellor.

suggestions.zh-CN: 如果同时伴有持续的情绪低落或焦虑，可以完成 PHQ-9 或 GAD-7 自评作进一步了解。
suggestions.en: If low mood or anxiety persist as well, the PHQ-9 or GAD-7 check-ins can give a fuller picture.
